rationale: The pain is real and technically specific, but evidence is thin: a single Stack Exchange question from one practitioner, with no corroborating threads, competitor pricing signals, or community volume to confirm this is a recurring, paid-for problem. The AppExchange ISV population is small (~10,000 partners globally), migrations happen infrequently per ISV, and no willingness-to-pay signal beyond an analogous competitor (Gearset) exists. Fails the 5-distinct-pain-quotes threshold.
